templates.name: Implement / Review / Fix
templates.summary: The current Codeness cycle: implement a useful unit, review it, fix the findings, then repeat until complete.

steps.name: Implement
steps.instructions: Start or continue one coherent, bounded work unit toward the goal. If the current handoff contains blocking findings, remediate that same work unit before selecting unrelated work; otherwise choose the next useful unit. Treat session history as context and the current handoff as scope authority. Necessary detours are allowed when they directly unblock correctness or validation: record why they are needed, keep them bounded, and return to the active work. Park unrelated discoveries for later planning. Inspect the repository, test the result, and stop at a coherent review point. Report work-unit readiness separately from overall-goal completion.

steps.name: Review
steps.instructions: Quality-assure the active work unit against its acceptance criteria and relevant goal constraints. Inspect the actual repository, tests, and diff, but do not modify files. Separate findings that block this work unit from optional improvements and unrelated discoveries that should be parked for later planning. Do not reopen resolved findings unless new evidence invalidates them. Classify the work unit as accepted, changes required, or blocked, and report overall-goal completion separately.

steps.name: Fix
steps.instructions: Address only the blocking review findings for the active work unit. Do not start an unrelated next unit. Necessary detours are allowed when they directly unblock a correct or testable fix: record them, keep them bounded, and return to the active work. Park optional or unrelated discoveries. Test the resulting repository and report whether the work unit is ready for review separately from whether the full goal still has work remaining.

coordinator.instructions: Create a concise, loss-minimizing handoff for the actual next configured step named in the routing context. Treat session history as memory and the current active work unit as scope authority. Preserve its objective and acceptance criteria, still-relevant plan decisions, changed files, validation evidence, unresolved blocking findings, necessary detours, parked discoveries, and blockers. Keep blocking, parked, and resolved work distinct; do not carry resolved findings forward as active work or promote unrelated discoveries into the current scope. Use the run label to describe the source step that just completed, not its recipient. Only at the last repeating step decide whether the full goal is complete, should continue for another loop, is blocked, or failed; do not infer overall completion merely because one work unit finished.

templates.name: Plan + Implement / Review / Fix
templates.summary: Create a read-only plan once, then run the implementation, review, and fix loop.

steps.name: Plan
steps.instructions: Inspect the repository and produce a durable plan for the full goal without modifying files. Divide the goal into coherent, bounded work units, identify breadth priorities and important architectural constraints, and select the first active unit. Define its objective, acceptance criteria, explicit non-goals, expected implementation surface, validation work, and any allowed necessary detours with a clear return condition. Park speculative or unrelated ideas for later work instead of expanding the active unit.

steps.name: Implement
steps.instructions: Implement the active bounded work unit from the durable plan and latest handoff. If the handoff contains blocking findings, remediate that same unit before advancing; if the prior unit is accepted, select the next planned unit. Treat session history as context and the current handoff as scope authority. Necessary detours are allowed when they directly unblock correctness or validation: record why they are needed, keep them bounded, and return to the active work. Park unrelated discoveries. Test the result and stop at a coherent review point.

steps.name: Review
steps.instructions: Quality-assure the active work unit against its acceptance criteria, the durable plan, and relevant goal constraints. Inspect the actual repository, tests, and diff, but do not modify files. Separate findings that block this work unit from optional improvements and unrelated discoveries that should be parked for later planning. Do not reopen resolved findings unless new evidence invalidates them. Classify the work unit as accepted, changes required, or blocked, and report overall-goal completion separately.

steps.name: Fix
steps.instructions: Address only the blocking review findings for the active work unit. Do not start unrelated work. Necessary detours are allowed when they directly unblock a correct or testable fix: record them, keep them bounded, and return to the active work. Park optional or unrelated discoveries. Test the result and report whether the work unit is ready for review separately from whether the full goal still needs another loop.

Keep blocking, parked, and resolved work distinct; do not carry resolved findings forward as active work or promote unrelated discoveries into the current scope. Use the run label to describe the source step that just completed, not its recipient.
